A customer's visit, drawn by ChatGPT

An art test for My Miniature Shop, a cozy pixel-art game about painting miniatures and running your own shop. ChatGPT drew every pose of this customer from a concept sheet. Code turns the drawings into clean pixel art and plays them along the real game's path through the shop: in from the street, a look into the glass case, over to the till, paying, the bag, and out again. (The shopkeeper is left out of this test.)
